name: 标准通用
desc: 忠实、通顺、中性，适用于大多数场景
prompt: Use clear, faithful, neutral modern prose. Preserve the original meaning precisely without adding or omitting information.

name: 正式公文
desc: 严谨书面语，适合合同、通知、公文
prompt: Use formal written register suitable for official documents and contracts. Prefer precise legal-administrative wording, avoid contractions and colloquialisms, keep modal verbs exact (shall/may/must).

name: 学术论文
desc: 客观、术语密集、句式规整
prompt: Use academic register. Prefer impersonal, objective constructions and discipline-standard terminology. Keep hedging expressions (may suggest, indicates) intact and preserve citation markers verbatim.

name: 技术文档
desc: 简洁准确，保留命令、参数与代码
prompt: Use concise technical documentation style. Keep all identifiers, CLI flags, file paths, API names, version numbers and code fragments unchanged. Prefer imperative mood for procedures.

name: 商务沟通
prompt: Use professional business communication register: polite, concise, action-oriented. Keep greetings and closings natural in the target culture.

name: 口语自然
desc: 轻松自然，像母语者日常表达
prompt: Use natural conversational register as a native speaker would speak. Prioritize fluency and idiom over literal correspondence, but never change facts, numbers or names.
